Security Core
Details ↷

100% Offline Engine

Runs completely without internet access. All student records remain locally stored on the user's computer inside IndexedDB.

Zero Cloud LatencyIndexedDB Storage100% Offline
Full Specification

100% Offline Architecture

  • Zero Internet Prerequisite: FormEase Pro operates at full capacity in remote schools without WiFi or cellular data.
  • Ultra-Fast IndexedDB: Near-instantaneous database lookups, filtering, and exports powered by local browser storage.
  • No Server Downtime: Immunity from server crashes, slow networks, or maintenance outages during peak grading deadlines.
  • Local Hardware Accelerated: Fast responsive performance on both modern PCs and older school laptops.
✓ DepEd Order & MATATAG 100% Compliant
Legal Privacy
Details ↷

RA 10173 Data Privacy Compliance

Zero cloud data harvesting or telemetry. Fulfills all technical and organizational data privacy requirements under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012.

RA 10173 CompliantZero TelemetryDepEd Order 001 s. 2024
Full Specification

RA 10173 Data Privacy Compliance

  • Absolute Data Isolation: Learner LRNs, grades, health records, and parent data never leave the teacher's machine.
  • Zero Cloud Harvesting: No third-party telemetry, tracking pixels, or background data collection.
  • DepEd Order 001 s. 2024 Aligned: Complies with guidelines regarding protection of learner information.
  • School Controller Sovereignty: The school and educator maintain exclusive legal ownership over all processed records.
✓ DepEd Order & MATATAG 100% Compliant
Encryption
Details ↷

AES-256-GCM Encrypted Backups

One-click snapshot database backups (.formease / JSON) protected by AES-256-GCM cipher and PBKDF2 key derivation.

AES-256-GCMPBKDF2 Key Derivation.formease Backups
Full Specification

AES-256-GCM Encrypted Backups

  • Military-Grade Cipher: Industry-standard AES-256-GCM encryption ensures database backups cannot be intercepted or read.
  • Password-Protected Snapshots: Teachers set personal encryption passwords with PBKDF2 key derivation.
  • 1-Click Disaster Recovery: Restore entire school databases (students, sections, grades, attendance) seamlessly from a single file.
  • JSON Rescue Export: Fallback plain-text database rescue exporter for maximum data portability.
✓ DepEd Order & MATATAG 100% Compliant
Cloud Backup Option
Details ↷

Optional Google Drive Sync

Google Drive BackupUser ControlledDisaster Recovery
Full Specification

Optional Google Drive Sync

  • Direct Client-to-Drive: Connects directly between the local browser and the teacher's personal Google Drive folder.
  • Zero Intermediary Server: Backups transmit directly to Google without passing through any FormEase server.
  • Encrypted in Transit & Rest: Backups stored in Google Drive retain AES-256-GCM encryption.
  • Completely Voluntary: Teachers who prefer 100% offline local-only storage can leave cloud backup disabled.
✓ DepEd Order & MATATAG 100% Compliant
